method.name: print_type
method.description: Print the type of the variant.

class.name: WFC
class.description: Procedural generator of 2D pixel textures based on the Wave Function Collapse algorithm. It takes an input image and generates a new image that resembles the input based on adjacency constraints.

method.name: autocompleteImage
method.description: Fills remaining empty pixels in the output image using the WFC algorithm.

method.name: erasePatternAtPosition
method.description: Returns true if the pattern was successfully erased, false otherwise. Cells collapsed via "autocompleteImage" cannot be erased this way.

method.name: getPatternTextures
method.description: Returns the textures of all patterns extracted from the input image, in the order they were found.

method.name: resetImage
method.description: Resets the output image to its initial blank state.

method.name: fixPatternsAtPositions
method.description: Returns true if all the patterns were successfully set, false otherwise. Cells that are already collapsed cannot be overwritten.

method.name: validCellsForPattern
method.description: Returns a texture highlighting the valid cells where the specified pattern can be placed. Valid cells are marked in white, while invalid cells are marked in black.

members.member: Configuration resource for the WFC algorithm. It contains parameters such as output image size, pattern size, boundary conditions, and more.

class.name: WFCConfig
class.brief_description: Configuration file for the Wave Function Collapse algorithm.
class.description: Configuration file for the Wave Function Collapse algorithm. Required to configure the WFC node.

members.member: How to treat the input image around its boundaries. Default is NONE, which treats the boundaries as hard edges. PERIODIC_X(Y) repeats the image in the horizontal (vertical) axis. PERIODIC combines PERIODIC_X and PERIODIC_Y.
Mechanism to choose the next cell to collapse. Default is SCANLINE, which chooses the next cell in a scanline order. ENTROPY chooses the cell with the lowest entropy.
Forces the boundaries of the output image to use only patterns that are present in the boundaries of the input image.
Size (in pixels) of the patterns used in the WFC algorithm.
Random seed for the WFC algorithm. Default is -1, which uses a random seed. For reproducible results, set a positive seed value.
Index of the starting cell for the WFC algorithm. Default is -1, which lets the algorithm choose the starting cell randomly.
Trigger transformations (rotations and reflections) on the input image to extract more patterns. Default is 0, which means no transformations.
